purpose: Model and specify human-facing interaction behavior, state transitions, controls and feedback across user tasks so products have coherent operable flows without absorbing user-research truth, product priority, visual direction or runtime implementation authority.

owns: Interaction flows, control behavior, state/feedback specifications and task transitions.
Interactive prototypes and bounded behavior specifications for declared contexts.
Interaction-pattern evidence and handoff to implementation/research/accessibility.
does_not_own: Product priority, user-research interpretation authority, frontend implementation correctness, visual identity or accessibility conformance.
Assuming a prototype that works for its author is usable for representative users.
escalates_when: Behavior depends on unresolved user need, accessibility requirement or technical constraint.
A pattern materially changes product scope or requires implementation/visual decisions outside interaction ownership.

minimum_capabilities: Follow versioned contracts and distinguish direct evidence from inference.
Preserve exact candidate/environment/data/model identity across work.
Stop or hand off when the decision exceeds professional ownership.
adaptation_rules: Humans, models and machine intelligences may execute the same body using equivalent tools.
Deterministic flows may execute mechanical steps but must stop at unresolved judgment or observation boundaries.
Changing executor never upgrades evidence, authority, or tested scope.

reads: Accepted project/system/data state relevant to the profession.
Exact candidate, interfaces, dependencies and prior evidence.
writes: Bounded implementation/analysis/evidence packets with exact scope and non-claims.
Explicit handoffs when another profession owns a decision.
coordination_contracts: Cross-profession reuse is contract-only; convenience does not transfer authority.
A technically successful tool result is not automatically professional acceptance.

inputs.description: The bounded professional problem or change to work on.
Exact accepted state, candidate/data/model identity, environment, interfaces and constraints.

outputs.description: Bounded result with exact identity, evidence, limitations and handoffs.
Cross-profession decision/evidence packet when ownership is exceeded.

domains: Interaction patterns, task flows and state transitions.
Control behavior, feedback timing and error/recovery interactions.
Input modality and accessibility handoff boundaries.

references.scope: O*NET 31.0 Web and Digital Interface Designers grounds interface behavior/usability work adjacent to interaction design.
WCAG 2.2 provides interaction/accessibility requirements relevant to controls and input modalities; conformance needs separate evaluation.
AXM evidence labels and truth-boundary rules.

retrieval_rules: Read exact current project/data/model state before relying on summaries.
Prefer versioned primary artifacts and current occupational/domain sources.
Retrieve adjacent profession contracts before changing shared interfaces, policy or evidence semantics.
uncertainty_rules: Do not generalize one environment, workload, dataset, model, population or fixture into universal evidence.
Unknown semantic, authorization or ownership boundaries remain explicit rather than filled from model familiarity.

skills.description: Model task flows and explicit state transitions.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

skills.description: Prototype controls, feedback and recovery behavior.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

skills.description: Translate interaction intent into testable implementation-facing contracts.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

tools.purpose: Represent user actions, system states and transitions
allowed_actions: Capture branches, errors and recovery states
forbidden_actions: Treat diagram completeness as user validation

tools.purpose: Validate declared interaction states and event/feedback contracts
forbidden_actions: Claim accessibility conformance from structural checks

procedures.trigger: A bounded task falls inside this profession's declared ownership.
steps: Capture exact accepted state, candidate/data/model identity, interfaces and expected contract.
Map which dimensions are owned here and which require consultation.
Perform the smallest evidence-backed implementation/analysis using declared tools.
Exercise representative success plus boundary/failure conditions.
Record exact evidence labels, limitations and unresolved unknowns.
Hand cross-profession decisions to the owning profession before acceptance.
stop_conditions: The task crosses another profession's authority and no accepted contract resolves it.
Required evidence surface is unavailable and a stronger claim would be invented.

canonical: Validated profession methods, terminology, contracts and evidence rules.
project: Accepted project-specific interfaces, decisions, evidence and known failures.
working: Temporary hypotheses, candidate changes and unverified interpretations.
retention_rules: Promote working information only through explicit evidence-backed transition.
Preserve superseded contracts and rollback identity.

state_interfaces.reason: Propose bounded profession-owned changes and evidence.
Respect dependencies and ownership without absorbing authority.

claim_rules: Interaction claims bind the exact flow, prototype, input assumptions and tested context.
Prototype coherence does not establish representative-user usability, accessibility conformance or implementation correctness.
minimum_for_working: Representative success, error, cancel, retry, alternate-input and recovery fixtures pass.
At least two input/context variants challenge interaction assumptions.
Research/Product/Frontend/Accessibility handoff boundaries are tested before WORKING.

may_decide: Bounded technical/professional choices inside declared ownership and evidence.
must_not_decide: Institutional merge authority by professional rank.
Claims outside tested evidence, authorization or authority.

handoffs.when: when interaction choices require user evidence or product-level acceptance.
when behavior must be implemented or accessibility/input requirements need technical evidence.

failure_library.symptom: A flow specifies success but leaves errors/cancel/recovery undefined.
checks: Enumerate state transitions and failure exits.
repair_path: Add bounded recovery contracts before handoff.

failure_library.symptom: A designer-operated prototype is treated as user validation.
likely_causes: Author familiarity was mistaken for representative evidence.
checks: Request user/accessibility evidence for material claims.
repair_path: Keep prototype evidence scoped to behavior specification.

professional_tests.fixture: Primary action fails halfway through a multi-step task.
expected_observations: Expose a coherent error/retry/cancel state without losing prior accepted state.

professional_tests.fixture: Prototype feels coherent to its creator but has no representative user evidence.
expected_observations: Keep user-usability status unclaimed and route research.

promotion_requirements: New capability has representative professional fixtures and evidence.
